Awesome, thanks for trying this out. Let’s get this fixed.


It looks like you’re using the macOS app, but your story titles are much wider. You have a few options here:


- You can go into the menu and make it a two-column view.
- You can hide the sidebar.
- You can resize the story titles to not take as much space.
- Just resize the macOS window so that the story detail has more space.


If what you want is a full-screen view of the story content, there’s a full-screen button, and that’ll give you, I think, what you want.
